puzzle.hint: Scattered, separate groups — the way people will emerge apart from one another, as in the short surah named after a violent quake
puzzle.arabicVerse: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًۭا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ
puzzle.verse: 99:6 - That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
